test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides directives to the state for taking steps to raise the standard of living?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 47**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 47** of the Constitution of India is part of the **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP).**
 
• It directs the state to aim at raising the **standard of living** of its people and improving **public health.**
 
• Under Article 47, the state is also required to **endeavor to prohibit the consumption of intoxicating drinks and drugs**, which are injurious to health.
 
• This article emphasizes the importance of **nutrition, standard of living, and public health** as essential elements for the well-being of citizens.
 
• The **Directive Principles of State Policy** are non-justiciable in nature, meaning they cannot be enforced by the courts, but they are fundamental in the governance of the country.
 
• **Article 47** reflects the commitment of the state to social welfare and equitable development.
 
• It forms an important foundation for policies related to **health care, food security, and eradication of malnutrition** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 50**__

 __
 
• **Article 50** deals with the **separation of judiciary from the executive**. It directs the state to ensure the independence of the judiciary from the executive machinery.
 
• Its primary objective is to establish an independent judicial system for fair and unbiased administration of justice.
 
 
 
• **Article 48**__
 __
 
• **Article 48** focuses on the **organization of agriculture and animal husbandry**.
 
• It directs the state to take steps for preserving and improving the **breeds of cattle** and prohibiting the slaughter of cows and other milch and draught animals.
 
 
 
• **Article 49**__
 
 
• **Article 49** pertains to the protection of **monuments and places of national importance**.
 
• It directs the state to safeguard objects of historical significance from destruction and damage.
